queue_generation_method.target_window: March 16-31, joined separately only for retrospective analysis and not used for queue membership or predictive inputs

full_early_period_action_queue.purpose: All eligible pages ranked for human review using March 1-15 information only

historical_evaluable_subset.purpose: Retrospective decline-proxy association and outcome analysis only; not used for queue membership

validation_limits: Metrics apply to the 16-date historical evaluable subset, not to the full early-period action queue.
The grouped holdout uses 8 test clients and zero client overlap, so confidence is limited.
The proxy is historical association and not future decline or refresh benefit.
The action queue uses March 1-15 features and the Week 4 baseline, not held-out logistic probabilities or later-period availability.
public_safety: No private names, URLs, raw queries, tokens, target-derived columns, or late-period fields are exported in the action queue.
